Jane M: Heads up — Vega vendor invoices from the nightly run have weird lines. Some customers got a Supplier Credit duplicated, others got their reserved compute line removed. Can someone pull the job logs?
Samir P: Yikes. Any customers impacted publicly yet?
Maria (Finance): We received 3 support tickets. No public outage, just invoice disputes.
Evan S: I'm on it. Spinning up the job logs now.
BillingBot: [automated] invoice-gen job 2024-03-22T03:12:16Z completed with warnings (3 warnings, 0 hard failures)
Evan S: Quick log snippet: `WARN: template_merge: line_items.vendor_credit matched template_v2 and template_override, keeping both`
Evan S: There's a template override for Vega we rolled last week — looks like the merge rule changed from dedupe-by-sku to append-on-conflict.
Jane M: That sounds like a risky default. Did the override get applied only to Vega?
DevOps Eng: Yes, override is scoped to vendor_id=vega-001. It was intended to add an extra pass-through credit for partner facilitation.
Maria (Finance): The extra credit is correct for partner reports but it should be a single aggregated credit, not a separate line. Duplicate lines confuse accounting exports.
Samir P: Are amounts wrong or just duplicated lines?
Evan S: Both. For 2 customers we saw the credit split into two lines of 50% each due to rounding; net was same but export plugins interpreted them as two credits and zeroed the reserved compute line in a downstream mapping script.
Maria (Finance): So rounding + duplicate line -> mapping script logic `if credit_count > 1 then prefer credits_and_drop_reserved` kicked in. Bad interaction.
Jane M: Can we revert the template override immediately and re-run the nightly job for the affected accounts only?
DevOps Eng: We can revert the template with a hotfix. Re-run would need idempotent job with a dry-run first.
Evan S: Proposed plan: 1) rollback template override for vega-001 2) add dedupe-by-sku fallback 3) re-run invoice-gen in dry-run to confirm 4) run live for the 3 impacted customers with manual approval.
Maria (Finance): Please include ledger export diff in the dry-run so we can sign off.
Samir P: Approve for the 3 customers once we see the diff. 
Jane M: tagging @ops and @billing for visibility. :eyes:
Evan S: Patch ready in branch `fix/vega-template-merge`. Patch diff: ```- if conflict: append
+ if conflict: dedupe_by_sku then aggregate_amounts```
DevOps Eng: Deploying patch to staging now. ETA 10m.
BillingBot: [automated] deploy pipeline started for branch fix/vega-template-merge (build 3187)
Evan S: Staging dry-run looks clean. Sample export: `customer: ACME
 before: reserved_line: $1200, credits: [$-50, $-50]
 after: reserved_line: $1200, credits: [$-100]`
Maria (Finance): That diff is perfect. Approving live run for the 3 tickets.
Samir P: I'll notify the customers once the corrected invoice is reissued.
Jane M: Great. Follow-up: create a short postmortem and add a unit test to prevent changes to merge semantics without a migration note.
DevOps Eng: Filed: FIN-INC-2024-03-vega-template in ops board.
BillingBot: [automated] reissue job queued for customers [acct_332, acct_778, acct_912] by Evan S
Evan S: Reissue completed for 3 accounts. I'm attaching the reissued invoice links: https://invoices.internal/332 (reissued), https://invoices.internal/778 (reissued), https://invoices.internal/912 (reissued)
Maria (Finance): Confirmed updated ledger, tickets closed, customers notified. Thanks team. :tada:
Jane M: Closing this thread. Please include the postmortem link once ready.
Samir P: Thanks all.
